message: ぱいコン

name: Lolotte
message: 「I see. So with the arrival of the trainee, Senpai's throne as the Boob Queen is in jeopardy.」

name: Ria
message: 「I-I'd really rather you didn't call me that...」

name: Misa
message: 「Senpai is n-n-not a Boob Queen or anything like that!」

name: Helena
message: 「'Tsk, tsk, tsk. That's why you're still just a kid.'」

name: Ria
message: 「S-Sis!? Since when were you here!?」

name: Ria
message: 「Ah, Sis, stooop」

name: Paqy
message: 「Ooooh」

name: Helena
message: 「This volume! This firmness! This shape! And on top of that, this sensitivity! The Boob Queen is undoubtedly Ria.」

name: Ria
message: 「A-Aaah. Nn, nfuun, nooo」
Squeezed out by Helena-san's hands, Senpai's breasts are a visual assault!
I know I shouldn't look, yet I can't look away!

name: Ria
message: 「Cut it out already!」

name: Helena
message: 「Getting all worked up. Though that's cute too.」

name: Ria
message: 「W-What did you even come here for, Sis!」

name: Helena
message: 「I dragged in an officer who was loitering in front of the door, so praise me.」

name: Azel
message: 「I-I was not loitering.」

name: Synn
message: 「You could've just come on in.」

name: Azel
message: 「I merely happened to be passing by. I'm going home.」

name: Helena
message: 「No can do, Azel-chan. Now that you've become the Assistant Acting Recorder, attending the Student Council is mandatory.」

name: Azel
message: 「Is it mandatory?」

name: Synn
message: 「Who knows? I've never really thought about it.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I believe it goes without saying.」

name: Helena
message: 「It's an obligation」

name: Sally
message: 「Obligations and stuff are such a pain」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It was an obligation? I just assumed everyone was here because it's fun」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Huh? Did I say something weird?」

name: Misa
message: 「That's so like you, Lolotte-san」

name: Synn
message: 「Aren't you having fun, Misa?」

name: Misa
message: 「I-It's not like I'm having fun because of you, Sakura-kun」

name: Sally
message: 「Ooh, me too, me too! It's fun, and we get snacks too!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「It's all about the food for you!」

name: Ria
message: 「That's just like Sally-chan」

name: Azel
message: 「An obligation is a duty one must fulfill according to their position. Whether it is fun or not is irrelevant」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, but there's no rule saying it can't be fun, right?」

name: Synn
message: 「Doing your duty and having fun! That's the best」

name: Helena
message: 「Having fun is great and all, but you need to start preparing for the next big event soon」

name: Synn
message: 「The Holy Night Festival, right」

name: Helena
message: 「I'm looking forward to seeing what kind of plans you all come up with」

name: Azel
message: 「What is the Holy Night Festival?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Look at Aze-kou being proactive」

name: Azel
message: 「...It's an obligation」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ooh, ooh! I don't know either!」

name: Sally
message: 「Well, I don't know either! Take that!」

name: Ria
message: 「Lolotte-chan, Azel-chan, and Sally-chan. None of you were here last year, after all」

name: Synn
message: 「The Holy Night Festival is December's main event」

name: Sally
message: 「Will there be tons of yummy food like at KiraFes!?」

name: Ria
message: 「There probably won't be much food」

name: Sally
message: 「What a bummer」

name: Nanaka
message: 「It's an event where you celebrate Christmas by singing hymns and stuff, after all. It's a liiittle plain」

name: Ria
message: 「You looked lovely singing in the choir, Misa-chan」

name: Misa
message: 「T-To think Big Sister was watching me... I'm deeply moved!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Produce corps... So everyone gathers bringing vegetables and fruits, right?」

name: Sally
message: 「Oh, so there IS food! I vote for meat too! And beef bowls!」

name: Misa
message: 「Not that kind! Sacred songs!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Last year we just participated, so this year we're on the organizing side, huh」

name: Synn
message: 「KiraFes was a success, so it'll go well this time too」

name: Azel
message: 「Why hold events at all」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, officially that's just how it's decided, though」

name: Azel
message: 「Tradition, huh. Pointless」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm excited. Because we've got a chance to use our own strength to make it even more fun and wonderful!」

name: Misa
message: 「Honestly, Sakura-kun, you're always so impulsive. How are you going to make it fun, specifically?」

name: Synn
message: 「For example... coming up with new attractions or something」

name: Lolotte
message: 「How about choosing a Boob Queen! It's sure to get everyone hyped up!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「The 'Boob Queen Contest,' or 'Boob-Con' for short」

name: Ria & Nanaka
message: 「Objection!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「You don't have confidence, Treasurer?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What was that?! What matters is shape! Not size! Right, Azel, you agree too, don't you?」

name: Azel
message: 「Don't care」
